provider_family: KnowInk Tally Election Night Reporting / TotalResults API

county_coverage.coverage: All Arkansas counties represented as county FIPS locations in each tested statewide race response.
county_coverage.notes: Contest response includes county aggregate candidate vote totals under response.locations; it also reports reporting precinct counts. Use the statewide race endpoint once per race rather than requesting each county separately.

license.status: No separate API/data license identified on the SOS results page, Tally ENR page, app configuration, or tested API responses.
license.source_terms: SOS page is the official public entry point. The SOS page states the Secretary of State site is copyrighted; follow applicable state/vendor terms and verify reuse rights before redistribution.

status: Working, live, unofficial election-night results. Responses tested successfully; 2026 race is not marked official.

evidence.claim: SOS links the 2026 General Election & Judicial Runoff to arkansas.tally-enr.com and notes the transition to a new election-night reporting vendor.
Public site app configuration identifies the TotalResults API and public results hosts.
The API election list supplied the 2026 election ID, which was then used for metadata and contest requests.
Live metadata reports the current election, update time, version, and unofficial status.
Both tested single-contest endpoints return county aggregate candidate counts for 75 locations.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 75 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
